<section id="ledgercore-documentation">
<h1>ledgercore documentation</h1>
<p>Welcome to the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> documentation.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> is a small, typed Python library for projects that store structured
records as files. It provides reusable primitives for atomic writes, YAML front
matter, deterministic JSON/YAML storage, safe relative paths, config discovery,
numeric IDs, and cross-ledger references.</p>
<section id="installation">
<h2>Installation</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>ledgercore
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Requirements: Python 3.10+, PyYAML.</p>
</section>
<section id="quick-start">
<h2>Quick start</h2>
<p>See the <a class="reference external" href="https://github.com/ledgerwerk/ledgercore#readme">project README</a> for a
hands-on introduction.</p>
